title: Kernel generator
description: Scaffolds the backend shared kernel (Criteria, VO bases, TypeORM base repository, pipes, filters, config loaders) the generated modules build upon — copy-once, then owned by the consuming app

sharedDomainAlias.description: Import alias of the frontend/backend shared DTO lib (default '@acc/shared/domain')

models.description: Comma-separated model names to include (defaults to all registered models)

database.description: Persistence engine of the emitted app
